metadata.case_name: LAM WAH v. A.S. WATSON & CO LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: Senior cook (Park’n Shop at Olympian City, West Kowloon)

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to his back
source: On balance, I prefer to accept the evidence of the Plaintiff’s expert Dr. Lam. Hence, as a matter of findings at the accident, the Plaintiff suffered from soft tissue injury to his back, sprained right ankle and soft tissue to the knee. After treatment, the left knee recovered, but there was still significant back pain as well as residual pain at the right ankle.
the Employees’ Compensation Board certified that the Plaintiff suffered back injury resulting in residual back pain and right ankle pain.
He alleged that he had back sprain with bilateral lower limb numbness, right ankle pain, left elbow & left knee contusions while lifting a load on 21.12.05.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back
